comments.body_html: When playing the game in VR, I have a lot of difficulty aiming properly, perhaps because of the collision between the character’s body and the Buttstock of the gun. Will installing this mod solve this?

comments.author: YukoVR
comments.body_html:
SPT-VR 1.0 do have many aiming problems that stems from:
-2 options for aim smoothing on by default (VR tab of ingame settings) that seems to stuck my gun more than anything when on (I would recommend trying those off).
-character’s animations still impacting your gun (ex: goes up and down when you walk…)
-character’s animations still impacting the camera (ex: when you turn in place…)
-The aiming angle setting changes not applied when two handing weapons, some controllers result in odd aiming angles ingame which could lead into positions where they are more ocluded

Maybe on top of all that there is a collision problem (gotta try again to make sure).
and Nope, this mod turn invisible the body (via remodel, materials) and adapt the weight painting but doesn’t modify anything related to collision (which could create issues like for hit registrations).

Also, If your headset uses cameras for tracking, I would recommend not getting your controllers to close to the headset/behind so they stay in view, hiding mirror’s and windows and getting the lighting right or even investing in a more precise tracking solution (ex: quest pro controllers, valve base station system). I guess a gunstock could help too but I never tried those.
